description: Move the 3-dot (kebab) action menu on resume tiles from top-left to top-right so it matches the job-application tiles. Minimal Tailwind class swap scoped strictly to the resume tile component, zero regression on other pages.

userStories.title: Move resume tile kebab menu to top-right
userStories.description: As a user viewing my resumes dashboard, I want the 3-dot action menu to appear in the top-right corner of each resume tile so it matches the job-applications page.
acceptanceCriteria: Resume tile kebab button is absolutely positioned in the top-right corner of the card
Top/right offsets visually match the job-application tile kebab button
Dropdown menu opens right-aligned to the button (same as job-application tiles)
Clicking the button still opens the same actions menu (edit, delete, duplicate, etc.)
Change is a minimal Tailwind class swap — no structural JSX refactor
No modifications to job-application tile component or any other tile/page
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
